title: first100-flake-registry
description: Maintainer decision BLOCKED-007 item 3 (2026-09-01): an append-only registry of tests confirmed flaky in this CI environment, independent of any First-100 slice's own changes. When a CI run's failing-test set is a subset of this registry's entries, that run's observation is a VALID observation for every other test in it -- no rerun needed for that reason alone (generate-ledger.mjs's checkObservationAgainstFlakeRegistry()). The registry never exempts a registered test from the suite itself: it still runs, still appears in the failure set, and a failure genuinely caused by the change under observation is never absorbed by this mechanism. Every entry requires >=2 occurrences on distinct candidate SHAs plus a note establishing non-association with the observed slice. A new entry is C7 flake-classification scope -- routed to the delegate, never self-classified by the Supervisor.

testFile.description: Repo-relative test file path, matching the vitest JSON report's testResults[].name suffix.

testFullName.description: The failing assertion's full name (vitest's assertionResults[].fullName), the same identity generate-ledger.mjs's expectCases matching already uses.

occurrences.description: Every occurrence must be on a distinct candidateSha (checked mechanically, not just by count).

unrelatedNote.description: Why this failure is not associated with the slices these CI runs actually observed -- e.g. distinct unrelated commits, or a commit touching zero product code.

registeredBy.description: Attribution for the classification decision, e.g. 'ANSWERED-BY-DELEGATE(gq-92)'.
